title: Homekey buildings in the older purchase, hotel and contract screens
question: Do the buildings bought with State Homekey awards show up in the City's purchase, operator or contract screens?
finding: Of 9 State Homekey buildings, 5 appear in an older purchase, hotel or contract screen (Homekey screens left out). 1 was first paid as a shelter hotel: 685 Ellis, paid $4.8 million as a hotel, then bought for $19.9 million from a seller who had held it 295 days, with a Homekey award of $18.2 million.
how: Homekey rows from housing_supply matched by street number and name, and by project name, to every published row of the older screens, leaving out the screens that are themselves about Homekey.
limits: Only rows identified by the linked screens are matched. Incomplete address records can leave a purchase unmatched. The operator of a Homekey building is not in the Homekey file.
